facts.activity_series: responding to a loss of containment

control_failures.control_label: secondary containment by bund and drainage
integrity of the mechanical seal support system

facts.title: unplanned release of pressure energy at TK-7102

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 3 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control BUND_AND_DRAINAGE_CONTAINMENT: the secondary containment by bund and drainage was in place but did not perform, and the accident investigation classified this as an absent or failed defence.

Control SEAL_SUPPORT_SYSTEM_INTEGRITY: the integrity of the mechanical seal support system was in place but did not perform, and the accident investigation classified this as an individual or team action.

recommendations: Restore the secondary containment by bund and drainage on TK-7102 and record the spot check before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in responding to a loss of containment, specifically isolating and depressuring a leaking system. TK-7102 (product storage tanks) is in service for export product storage. The task proceeded during a statutory inspection while the secondary containment by bund and drainage was in place but did not perform. The pressure energy involved is held as hydraulic accumulator, and the recorded presentation was jet release, stored-energy discharge, rupture.
response.summary: On 8 November 2007 a near hit was recorded on TK-7102 at Cape Verity Export Terminal during a statutory inspection; pressure energy held as hydraulic accumulator was not released.
